purpose: Reviewed context exceptions for the report-only copy check; never automatic replacements or build failures.

exceptions.reason: Keep the exact setting name in technical migration instructions; explain its effect for a business owner.
Keep when an old address must lead to the correct replacement page; do not erase a URL-preservation obligation.
Keep where it distinguishes an actual service area from a business address, or accurately quotes a source.
Keep in quoted proposal terms, download titles and precise limits; prefer agreed work in general explanations.
Keep wherever the customer's consent controls payment, publication, work or access.
Keep when referring to an actual host, mail service or other outside supplier; name the business in owner-facing examples.
Keep in technical records and attributed source explanations; name the photo, check or record in ordinary instructions.
Keep for legally typed places in sourced directories; do not relabel boroughs, villages or townships as towns.
